question: The Koya movement in Malkangiri, during 1880, (now in Odisha) was led by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tama Dora.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tama Dora:-**

 
 
• He led the Koya movement in Malkangiri in 1880.
 
 
 
• **Koya movement:-**
 
 
• The Koya movement was a tribal revolt against British colonial rule and the oppressive zamindari system.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Koya people:-**

 
 
• The Koya people are an indigenous tribe in India, primarily found in the states of Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, and Chhattisgarh.
 
• The Koya language is part of the Dravidian language family and is spoken by approximately 300,000 people.
